text_version.note: AGORA record covers part of an act: An act to add Section 11546.45.5 to the Government Code, relating to automated decision systems

territorial_scope.description: Applies to California state agencies as defined in the section; the text reaches no actors outside the state's own agencies.

evidence.quote: “State agency” means any of the following:

summary.short: Adds Government Code § 11546.45.5, requiring the Department of Technology to inventory high-risk automated decision systems used, developed or procured by California state agencies by September 1, 2024, and to report the inventory annually to legislative committees from January 1, 2025.
summary.long: Adds Government Code section 11546.45.5. It defines automated decision system, high-risk automated decision system, state agency and board, and excludes the University of California, the Legislature, the judicial branch and boards except as provided. By September 1, 2024, the Department of Technology must conduct, in coordination with other interagency bodies as it deems appropriate, an inventory of high-risk automated decision systems proposed for, or in use, development or procurement by state agencies. The inventory must describe each system's decisions and intended benefits, alternatives, research results on efficacy, categories of data and personal information used, and measures in place, if any, to mitigate risks such as cybersecurity risk and biased decisions. From January 1, 2025 and annually thereafter, the department must submit a report of the inventory to the Assembly Committee on Privacy and Consumer Protection and the Senate Committee on Governmental Organization. The reporting requirement becomes inoperative on January 1, 2029. The text sets no penalties and creates no private right of action.

relations.note: Adds new Section 11546.45.5 to the Government Code (Section 1 of the act). The target code is not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is left empty.
